performance.verdict: SOW delivery is the real crisis; paid efficiency collapse is secondary.

findings.text: 10 of 10 SOW milestones are overdue (earliest due 2026-07-31); pre-launch stack test, CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, and Phase 1 close all undelivered as of 2026-10-11.

CPL spiked 64.68% last 7 days with spend up 16.87% and leads down 29.03%; 3-day signal (Oct 8–10: 9+6+5=20 leads, $255/day spend) vs prior 3 days (Oct 5–7: 2+0+2=4 leads, $23/day spend) — ratio worsens as daily budget jumped ~3.5x with only 5x leads, implying CPL near $12–17 in the surge vs ~$7.34 28-day baseline.

MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP consumed $882.15 of $976.58 (90%) in 28 days; zero spend days on Sep 24–26 followed by an abrupt jump to $85/day suggests manual budget manipulation or campaign disruption rather than steady delivery.
GBP actions dropped 33.33% in 7d; last 2 days (Oct 9–10) show 0 GBP actions, breaking a prior pattern of 2–11 actions/day — organic floor is eroding with no paid diversification to compensate.

GA4 sessions rose 93.81% week-over-week (e.g., 107–101 sessions on Oct 7–9) while GA4 conversions remain at 0 for the full 28-day window and GHL pipeline data is null — leads are arriving but zero downstream conversion signal exists; intake or tracking is broken.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 10 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid scale until pre-launch stack test and tracking are confirmed live.
suggestions.monday_update: All 10 SOW milestones due by 2026-07-31 through 2026-09-30 remain undelivered as of 2026-10-11. Nacer to produce a written status and revised delivery date for each item (pre-launch stack test, Como→GHL migration, CAPI, landing pages, search campaigns, LSA, nurture sequences, Phase 1 close) by end of week. Success check: at minimum, pre-launch stack test and landing page + tracking confirmed live by 2026-10-18, unlocking any further paid budget decisions.

suggestions.text: Hold MDST-WES-AWARE-WHTAPP at current daily budget; watch CPL vs $7.34 baseline over next 3 days before any scale or kill decision.
suggestions.monday_update: The top campaign drove CPL up 64.68% while spend rose 16.87% and leads fell 29.03% in the last 7 days. Do not increase the daily budget (~$85/day) until 3 consecutive days of data are available post-2026-10-11. Success check: if CPL returns toward the $7.34 28-day baseline by 2026-10-14, a scale consideration is appropriate; if CPL remains above $12 for 3 days, a creative refresh or kill decision is warranted.

suggestions.text: Investigate GHL null pipeline and GA4 zero-conversion state; confirm leads from Meta are creating GHL opportunities, targeting fix before next spend cycle.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL pipeline data returned null and GA4 shows 0 conversions over 28 days despite 133 Meta leads recorded, pointing to an intake or tracking break rather than an ads problem. Nacer to confirm whether Meta leads are appearing in GHL as opportunities and whether the GA4 conversion event is firing correctly. Success check: at least 1 confirmed lead-to-opportunity path visible in GHL by 2026-10-14, with GA4 conversion event validated.
